description: The record of what has been looked up through Cairn - which tool, when, and whether by an assistant or by the person on the Cairn page. Use for 'what did I ask about in June', 'what has been read from my account'. Kept for twelve months.

days.description: How many days back to look. Defaults to 90.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 30.

tool.description: Optional. Only lookups by a tool whose name contains this text.

name: get_cairn_history
title: Questions asked through Cairn
